value.rationale: The competing mechanisms of harvesting and prey counterattack create a biologically interpretable nonmonotone rare-predator invasion response. The exact global parameter criterion for zero/one/two harvest thresholds and the unique self-limitation cutoff separating backward from forward low-harvest coexistence are motivated structural boundaries not fixed by the originating article’s local eigenvalue test. The distinction between local invasion and nearby backward saddle equilibria matters for ecological interpretation; no broad novelty of reentrant invasion is claimed.
